newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent edges higher as NYMEX stays firm.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent edges higher as NYMEX stays firm.

text.p: September Brent futures edged higher in late trading on Thursday, supported by a firm NYMEX complex.
September Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $19.00 per barrel, up three cents from London overnight.
NYMEX September crude on the after-hours ACCESS trading system was last traded at $20.39 per barrel, up nine cents from New York.
Both markets remained underpinned by the August gasoline contract in the U.S., which surged by 3.43 cents per gallon to 69.90 on Wednesday. It added a further 0.60 to 70.50 on ACCESS trade.

However, brokers said upside would be limited, as speculative long positions in the August contract are closed or rolled ahead of the expiry later in New York, especially given the steep backwardation against the September contract.
In addition, Iraq is getting closer to a resumption of oil sales, which could see a flood of crude hitting the market in August.
